correctness.rationale: The exact T_r tuple recurrence handles equality, repetitions, and arbitrary alternating quantifiers. For n>=16 the two radius-two column windows and an available remote column determine every marked-pair rank-two type independently of global twist; singleton and empty-tuple types therefore stabilize. Exact enumeration of all 28 ordinary/twisted graphs for n=3..16 yields 13 classes, with twelve isolated small classes and one shared n>=9 class. The independent literal four-round game checks n=8 distinction and n=9 equivalence. The 18-vertex bound follows from the 9-rung earliest representative of the common class.

value.rationale: The result identifies the exact four-quantifier visibility boundary for twisting a finite cyclic strip, equates globally different gluings, completely classifies 13 rank-four theories, and proves sharp 18-vertex bounded testing. This is a natural structural logical invariant, not a routine computation of a prespecified small graph.
